rules.principle: The game never confirms, only reveals.
rules.description: Player-facing copy must not stamp an observation as Confirmed. Confidence lives in prose (Seemed to / Reliably), not a verdict label.

rules.principle: Unknown properties are omitted, not listed as empty slots.
rules.description: ??? in player-facing strings is a quest checklist. Show only what has been witnessed.
Journal list must not show observation counts such as (3 obs).

rules.principle: Diegetic surfaces are in the world. Zero-range Readable is a HUD with a marker component.
rules.description: perceivable_range / legible_range of 0.0 collapses proximity so a screen overlay can claim to be diegetic.
